programmes.show_description: From artisanal desserts to a city's costume change - watch Singapore flip from Christmas to Chinese New Year overnight, then feast on bak kwa and yu sheng for a prosperous start.
Why is the farming of pangasius in Vietnam so controversial, especially in the West? We investigate the mass production of this fish also known as dory, basa fish, and catfish.
Undercover Asia examines the Hong Kong protests through the lens of those caught in the middle: The police force, once Asia's finest, now - the most hated.
In 2018 China stops importing recyclables, creating global chaos and flooding Southeast Asian countries with unwanted plastic. For Indonesia, battling its own waste problems, is this the last straw?
Gallium is critical to green tech and China supplies 90% of it. So, when China began to restrict exports of gallium, it leads the world to eye other countries with this precious resource.
